security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; font-src 'self' data:; media-src 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: A memory game played on your own desktop icons
bundle.longDescription: Flip every desktop icon face down, draw them back at random, and place each one where you remember it. Save the new arrangement or restore the original.
